import functools, importlib
from sphinx.ext.napoleon.__init__ import _skip_member

class DummyConfig:
    napoleon_include_init_with_doc = True
    napoleon_include_private_with_doc = False
    napoleon_include_special_with_doc = False
class DummyApp:
    config = DummyConfig()
app = DummyApp()

# nested class in a module-like namespace
class Outer:
    class Inner:
        @functools.wraps(lambda self: None)
        def __init__(self):
            """Init docstring nested"""
            pass

# Ensure qualname has dot
print('qualname:', Outer.Inner.__init__.__qualname__)
res = _skip_member(app, 'class', '__init__', Outer.Inner.__init__, True, None)
print('skip nested?', res)
